ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Multicultural Advertising. "This course examines the impact of race and racial issues upon advertising both as a practice and as an industry. We¿ll examine advertising using a historical perspective and address issues of racial imagery in advertising, racial diversity in the industry, and examine current issues of multicultural advertising and marketing. In the process we¿ll also grapple with current theories on race and prejudice and their impact upon advertising." This section meets with ADV 590-R. This section open to juniors and seniors in the Advertising major only.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Advertising major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
